ambiguities: Swann's redirection of self-pity onto Odette ('la pitié qu'il eût pu s'inspirer à lui-même, ce fut pour elle qu'il la ressentit') and his temptation/rationalization about opening the letter addressed to Forcheville could be read as a subtle narrated diminishment of Swann (self-abnegation, moral compromise under jealousy).
